name: Kolaios is blown to Tartessos
summary: A Samian merchant bound for Egypt is driven west by an east wind, all the way through the Pillars of Heracles to Tartessos, a market no Greek had traded with. He came home with the richest cargo any Greek had ever carried, and dedicated a tenth of it at the temple of Hera.

stops.note: An island off Libya, where he leaves supplies for colonists from Thera.
An east wind that will not stop carries him through the Pillars to Tartessos, rich in silver.
Home with sixty talents; a bronze cauldron with griffin heads is made for Hera's temple.
